about: notice_received_nonpayment. Financial aid late; a notice taped to the door on 2026-09-28 demands $1,175 (rent plus a $75 late fee) by 2026-10-01; the tenant paid $550 by Zelle on 2026-09-29, accepted, no receipt. Panic, the late fee, and the partial payment, each a question the tool does not decide.

start.description: I couldn't pay my September rent ($1,100) because my financial aid refund came late. On September 28, 2026 I found a paper taped to my door that says I owe $1,175 (rent plus a $75 late fee) and I have to pay by October 1, 2026 or move out. I paid $550 through Zelle on September 29, 2026 and the landlord took it but didn't give me a receipt. I live in Gainesville, Alachua County. No court papers yet. I am not holding back any rent over repairs.
